task_text: I have a video call starting in 5 minutes. My desk area needs to look presentable and I should be able to see and hear clearly. The bedroom light is off.

central_instructions.R1: Stay in the living room and pass any necessary light objects to R2 for transport to the bedroom.
central_instructions.R2: Move to the bedroom to assist R3 and R4 by transporting light objects from the living room if needed.
central_instructions.R3: Turn on the bedroom light to ensure the area is well-lit for the video call.
central_instructions.R4: Organize and tidy up the desk area in the bedroom to make it presentable for the video call.

- R1 [PASS] Hands the lamp to R2 for transport to the bedroom. (r1_s2)
